C1.title: Know the four spots
C1.goal: In serve and return situations, learn where each of the four roles starts — and move as one unit with your partner.

C2.title: The first three balls
C2.goal: On the three balls right after the serve and return, read the height of the ball to decide whether to move in or back.

C3.title: Taking the net
C3.goal: After you send a low ball, take the net together, close off the angles, and hold your ground.

C4.title: When you're pushed
C4.goal: Under pressure, don't force it — reset with a lob, and cover the court when your partner gets pulled wide.

C5.title: Reading the opponents
C5.goal: Spot the opponents' formation, choose how to attack it, and plan a point two or three shots ahead.
